column3: MT 39:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; בַּהֲגִיגִי (“in my musing”) is rendered “While I was musing.”
Close to the Hebrew; חָדֵל (“transient”) is rendered “frail.”
Close to the Hebrew; “every man standing” is rendered “every man at his best state,” and הֶבֶל (“breath”) “vapor.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּצֶלֶם (“as an image”) is rendered “like a shadow,” and NKJV supplies “riches.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִתִּגְרַת (“the hostility”) is rendered “the blow.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his desired thing” is rendered “his beauty,” and “vanity” “vapor.”
Close to the Hebrew; גֵר (“a sojourner”) is rendered “a stranger,” and “a resident alien” “A sojourner.”
Close to the Hebrew; “look away from me” is rendered “Remove Your gaze from me,” and “be cheerful” “regain strength.”
